cutoff_split: Retain unchanged pre-payment predictors and the single incident group. No model, control cohort or train/test split.
dates: Public page extraction exposes relative posting times only; JSON metadata was inaccessible. Publication and original label-availability timestamps remain unknown. Reviewed/observed-by-project date is 2026-10-30.
evidence_policy: Require an author-explicit source/wallet address plus payment TXID and a matching observed input role. A receiving collector, consolidation, third-party summary, or similarity alone cannot create an owner label.
publication: Publish cohort IDs, hashes, source permalinks and narrowly scoped decisions. Keep raw address/assertion extracts local; omit unnecessary personal financial details.
requirement: Follow public owner/report-based leads from the external reconstructions; map exact identifiers to the fixed 500-source cohort.
selection: Lead-driven review of the Alvaro P. source registry, the owner-report statement in SomaxBT, and Coldcard Watch report documentation. Not a random sample or exhaustive victim search.
target_policy: Record first-person reported loss and declared hardware association separately from verified control, seed origin, firmware causation and signing device. No promotion of existing supervised labels.
unit: Publicly asserted source address linked to an exact reference payment; deduplicate reports by author and transaction.
